Adapted from the [standalone Resource example](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/healthcheck/examples/resource/index.md?view=context#resource), using only your six supplied resource values:

```hcl
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.0"

  required_providers {
    xcsh = {
      source  = "f5-sales-demo/xcsh"
      version = ">= 0.1.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "xcsh" {}

resource "xcsh_healthcheck" "synthetic_probe" {
  name      = "synthetic-probe"
  namespace = "synthetic-lab"

  healthy_threshold   = 3
  interval            = 10
  timeout             = 3
  unhealthy_threshold = 2
}
```

### Supplied field constraints

All six fields are **required** in the bundled **v12.4.0** provider schema.

| Field | Constraint |
|---|---|
| [`name`](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/healthcheck/properties/index.md?view=context#schema-name) | String; provider `NameValidator()`. Upstream documents DNS-1035 format, 1–63 characters, uniqueness within the namespace, and no rename during replacement. |
| [`namespace`](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/healthcheck/properties/index.md?view=context#schema-namespace) | String; provider `NamespaceValidator()`. Upstream documents a 1–63-character DNS label. |
| [`healthy_threshold`](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/healthcheck/properties/index.md?view=context#schema-healthy_threshold) | Provider-enforced integer **1–16**; successful checks before healthy. Startup requires only one success. |
| [`interval`](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/healthcheck/properties/index.md?view=context#schema-interval) | Provider-enforced integer **1–600 seconds** between requests. |
| [`timeout`](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/healthcheck/properties/index.md?view=context#schema-timeout) | Provider-enforced integer **1–600 seconds**; expiry counts as failure. |
| [`unhealthy_threshold`](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/healthcheck/properties/index.md?view=context#schema-unhealthy_threshold) | Provider-enforced integer **1–16**; failed checks before unhealthy. HTTP 503 bypasses this threshold. |

The supplied values satisfy these documented constraints. No protocol-specific configuration was added.

Configure `XCSH_API_URL` and one supported authentication method externally. [Prerequisites](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/healthcheck/index.md?view=context#prerequisites) document Standard tier and target-namespace access.

**Validation:** documentation-checked draft; Terraform validation and live apply were not run.
